level_one.title: Overwhelming Power
level_one.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 40% Attack Speed and causes Basic Attacks to heal for 15% of the damage dealt, increased by 50% of Sadism's bonus when hitting Heroes. These effects last for 4 seconds.

level_four.title: Show of Force
level_four.description: Heroes hit with 3 of Alarak's Abilities within 2 seconds take an additional 61 (+4% per level) damage and increase Sadism by 2%, stacking up to 20%.  Sadism gained from Show of Force is lost on death.

level_seven.title: Hindered Motion
level_seven.description: Telekinesis Slows enemies by 30% for 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Counter-Strike
level_ten.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Blade of the Highlord
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Sadism by 2% stacking up to 40%.  Sadism gained from Blade of the Highlord is lost on death.

level_sixteen.title: Lethal Onslaught
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 50% of Sadism's damage bonus to Alarak's Basic Attacks for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh this duration.

level_twenty.title: Last Laugh
level_twenty.description: Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes 3 times with Basic Abilities within 4 seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to 1.

level_one.title: Circle of Life
level_one.description: Quest: Collect Regeneration Globes.  Reward: After collecting 10 Regeneration Globes, Abundance heals for an additional 5% maximum Health.  Reward: After collecting 15 Regeneration Globes, Abundance's healing burst creates a Regeneration Globe.

level_four.title: Surge of Vitality
level_four.description: Abundance's healing burst grants allied Heroes 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Verdant Flourish
level_seven.description: Alexstrasza receives 40% more healing from Abundance and 100% more healing from Regeneration Globes.

level_ten.title: Life-Binder
level_ten.description: Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.  Dragonqueen: Cast range increased by 45%.

level_thirteen.title: Dragon Scales
level_thirteen.description: Gain 50 Armor while Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced, and for 2 seconds after. Can only trigger once every 10 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Overprotective
level_sixteen.description: Heroes healed by Abundance gain a Shield for 6 seconds equal to 70% of the amount healed.

level_twenty.title: Ritual of Life
level_twenty.description: Life-Binder activates 3 times over 6 seconds.

level_one.title: Flames of Fury
level_one.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Flame Buffet from 50 to 40.  Quest: Hit Burning enemy Heroes with Flame Buffet. 20 hits unlocks a Mythic Quest.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, hitting a Burning enemy Hero with Flame Buffet reduces Dragonqueen's cooldown by 6 seconds.  Mythic Quest: After hitting 40 more Heroes without dying, Dragonqueen damage against Heroes refreshes its duration.

level_four.title: Heat Exhaustion
level_four.description: Increase Flame Buffet's Slow from 40% to 50% and cause it to no longer decay.

level_seven.title: Fire Within
level_seven.description: Hitting a Burning Hero with Flame Buffet heals Alexstrasza for 10% of her maximum Health.

level_ten.description: After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor.
